main_issue: How to adjust the weeknight dinner rota during Ramadan so Agent D (fasting until about 7:10) can still eat together with the others, given Agent B must eat by 6:30.

A-B.evidence: A proposed 7:15 (T3), B said that was too late (T4); A later endorsed D's 6:30 sit-together plan (T9) and B agreed (T12).

A-C.evidence: A proposed moving dinner to 7:15 (T3) and C proposed 6:30 with D eating later (T5), which was compatible with D's plan. A asked C (T11) and C said 'that's fine' (T14).

A-D.evidence: A first proposed moving dinner to 7:15 (T3), then said D's plan 'works' (T9). D replied 'Yeah, exactly' (T10).

B-C.evidence: C's 6:30 proposal fit B's constraint (T5), and C pointed out that B has to eat at 6:30 (T7). Both accepted D's plan (T12, T14).

B-D.evidence: D wanted everyone to eat together (T6). D then proposed sitting with the others at 6:30 and eating at 7:10 (T8), which accommodates B's 6:30 limit, and B agreed (T12).

C-D.evidence: C suggested D eat later (T5) and D resisted (T6). D then adopted a version of it, sitting at 6:30 and eating at 7:10 (T8), and C agreed (T14).
